description: §22.4.1 (S459 round 4 F1) — `for` on `<label>` in compile-time `emit()` output is E-META-EVAL-002 (the same closed list).
rationale: §22.4.1: an attribute in `emit()` output SHALL carry a name on the closed list of §22.12; `for` is listed for `<output>` only. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
